messages:
Kim (CS): Ari from Vantix AP just replied: their ERP requires a single-page approval that lists the billing entity and vendor code before they can raise the PO. Our DocuSign envelope shows parent org only.
Owen (AM): Which billing entity do they need?
Ari (Customer Finance): Vantix Biotech Ltd, VAT GB55-1234. Vendor code VANT-502. They need the line-item split: $60k US seat license, $20k EU support.
Lydia (Ops): Can produce a one-page "procurement approval" PDF and email it directly. Do they need an executed signature?
Ari (Customer Finance): AP accepts a stub with signer name/title and a scanned signature. They prefer direct PDF to ap@vantix.co.uk.
Sam (Legal): Add clause: "This approval is for procurement routing only and does not amend the Agreement." Include signer fields and PO placeholder. For <$200k we can accept scanned sig with Box upload.
DocuSign Bot: Alert: envelope 1a2b3c4d metadata mismatch detected for billing_entity.
Lydia (Ops): Drafted stub and uploaded to Box: /Approvals/vantix/6223456789-approval-stub.pdf. DocSend link: https://docsend.com/view/vantix-stub-6223456789
Kim (CS): Sent options to Ari: (A) resend corrected DocuSign envelope, (B) emailed PDF stub, (C) wet-signed scan. Ari chose B.
Ari (Customer Finance): Received PDF, attaching to AP workflow now. Will notify once PO created.
Owen (AM): Created OPS ticket OPS-8204 to fix default envelope entity mapping so subsidiary populates next time.
Kim (CS): Closing thread pending PO number. Reopen if AP rejects the attachment.
